create_CPUMonitor: create a CPUFreq monitor instance with a collection interval and job UUID for CPU frequency monitoring
run_CPUMonitor: run the CPUFreq monitor to start a background thread that collects CPU frequency data periodically
collect_CPUFreq: collect current CPU frequency values from all CPUs and compute the average frequency in MHz
terminate_CPUMonitor: terminate the CPUFreq monitor by stopping the background collection thread and joining it
review_CPUMonitor: review the CPUFreq class to understand how it monitors CPU scaling frequency via sysfs
